gui.eg_entity_outlines.option.always_use: When enabled, always uses the high contrast outline style when targeting an entity. When disabled, the mod uses the vanilla accessibility setting to determine which outline style to use
gui.eg_entity_outlines.option.outline_ev: When enabled, completely ignores the entity whitelist and outlines every targetable entity
gui.eg_entity_outlines.option.invert_whi: When enabled, treats the whitelist as a blacklist; any entity that is enabled in the whitelist will not be outlined and vice-versa
